ruleDefinitions.name: Disable Windows IIS HTTP Logging
ruleDefinitions.description: Disables HTTP logging on a Windows IIS web server as seen by Threat Group 3390 (Bronze Union)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\appcmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "appcmd\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*set.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*config.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*section\\:httplogging.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*dontLog\\:true.*")))
